purpose: B5 executable coverage index for portable artifact routing. Each case names its fixture, assertion, and repository evidence.

cases.title: single and multi-app semantic routing
cases.assertion: canonical docs and app-scoped paths are distinct

cases.title: unknown virtual plugin routing
cases.assertion: producer name is not used to select an artifact path

cases.title: Superpowers default-path override
cases.assertion: docs/superpowers/specs|plans is denied and points to the canonical routing instruction

cases.title: common and app-specific prototype ownership
cases.assertion: prototype_owner is declared per app and never inferred from a plugin name

cases.title: update preserves user extensions
cases.assertion: managed block replacement preserves unmanaged bytes and files

cases.title: one-shot managed write enforcement
cases.assertion: new write deny, exact marker allow once, replay deny, existing edit allow

cases.title: wrong in-project Markdown path is denied
cases.assertion: noncanonical managed paths deny without writing and routing instruction remains the correction authority

cases.title: split Git topology
cases.assertion: root non-Git, docs Git and app Git topology remain represented

cases.title: host config merge and uninstall
cases.assertion: managed entries change while unrelated Claude settings remain

cases.title: Windows path and bypass boundary
cases.assertion: containment uses normalized separator and case rules; dynamic shell paths are bypass evidence

cases.title: installed and portable-only output equivalence
cases.assertion: both modes consume the same project-owned routing and format manifests

cases.title: idempotency and app update
cases.assertion: second approved apply is byte-identical and app identifiers stay manifest-driven

cases.title: external text normalization proposal
cases.fixture: external Markdown, MDX, TXT, RST, AsciiDoc
cases.assertion: required fields and UTF-8 proposal are inbox-first; marker-aware merge requires G12

cases.title: fixed-format inbox promotion boundary
cases.fixture: JSON, YAML, image and PDF external bundle
cases.assertion: source hash and proposal stay in _inbox; lossy automatic conversion is forbidden

cases.title: 22-skill artifact contract coverage
cases.assertion: 19 user plus 3 manager skills have routing profiles and unknown write capability is false

cases.title: four runtime combinations and trust transition
cases.assertion: routing contract remains shared and Codex becomes active only after explicit trust evidence
